liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd1990-03-16.sbd.munder.tetzeli.fix-5227.76037.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 181 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1990-03-16.nak300.juteau.116749.flac**: source not stated; 20 songs; 174 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1990-03-16.mtx.hansokolow.96549.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 167 min; rated 4.56/5 by 9 [5]
- **gd90-03-16.sbd.willy.5227.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 165 min; rated 4.17/5 by 30 [6]. Said about its sound: The set closer is completely trashed, though the recording is otherwise nice with minor glitches; A two-second dropout occurs, but the soundboard is crisp and the crowd noise is wild; The extended version is not as bad as it seemed, though the crowd is extremely excitable [20][23][29]
- **gd1990-03-16.sbd.miller.85201.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 166 min; rated 3.83/5 by 6 [8]

## Around the show

- The crowd goes wild during the break, giving the show an audience source feel [23]
- Audience left for facilities thinking it was halftime, then rushed back as the band returned [24]
- Bobby sang the song beautifully after two nights featuring other surprises [25]
- The lyrical re-write during the bust-out is awesome, and the crowd lights up with joy [27]
- Eyes of the World appears briefly in the jam, causing the crowd to go nuts [28]
- Brent and Jerry had great energy, and Jerry might have been playing the Wolf guitar [30]
- The previous night was Phil's 50th birthday, released as a limited edition Tarrapin Station [31]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-03-16.sbd.munder.tetzeli.fix-5227.76037.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: Seamless and patched edit of shnid 5227 [1]. Also: SHNs converted to FLAC, SBEs cleaned with shntool, and overlap between CDs 2 and 3 deleted [1]
- **gd1990-03-16.nak300.juteau.116749.flac**: transferred by Jeff Bowen;Brad Foster; source: Source: (OTS) Nakamichi cm300/cp4's > Sony TCD-D10; [4]. Also: The end of the song was patched using shnid 83791, and discs were extracted in secure mode [4]
- **gd1990-03-16.mtx.hansokolow.96549.flac16**: source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [5]. Also: Matrix created by hansokolow in ProTools from a soundboard source, with overlap between CDs 2 and 3 deleted [5]
- **gd90-03-16.sbd.willy.5227.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > ? > CDR> WAV>SHN [6]
- **gd1990-03-16.sbd.miller.85201.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat (44.1k) D [8]. Also: Sennheiser 4xx cassette master, transferred by Charles Bandrofcheck, with patch recorded by Jeff Hubbard [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Dave Goodwich: [30th Anniversary of The Grateful Dead's Spring 1990 Tour: The Capital Centre, Landover, MD 3/16/90 - Glide Magazine](https://glidemagazine.com/241539/30th-anniversary-of-grateful-deads-spring-1990-tour-3-16-90-the-capital-centre-landover-md/) [33]
- Fan art by keyboardpiano: [Grateful Dead Terrapin Station Spring 1990 Capital Centre](https://www.keyboardpiano.org/products/grateful-dead-terrapin-station-spring-1990-capital.html) [34]
